ebr5.label: EBR-5
ebr5.identifier_location: Observation, paragraph beginning The WGS; Figure 1 caption; Data availability
ebr5.review: The paper connects the named allele, locus and protein identifier to SCVM0123. Native-isolate measurements and heterologous-host comparisons are separate evidence. The accession is unversioned as reported; a UniProt entry or exact experimental construct is not yet assigned.
inspected: selected main-text identity and results paragraphs

prc1.label: PRC-1
prc1.review: The chromosome and named gene have distinct deposited identifiers. The paper distinguishes native-isolate susceptibility from the gene's heterologous-host effect and from biochemical activity; these cannot be substituted for one another. Homologous AmpC proteins are not PRC-1 identities.
prc1.access_note: Initial current-route navigation returned internal tool errors without an HTTP status. The legacy publisher route subsequently exposed the cited sections; no access-denial response was bypassed.

psz1.label: PSZ-1
psz1.identifier_location: Accession numbers; Identification and genome characterization; Figure 1 caption
psz1.review: The paper reports chromosome, plasmid and gene identifiers separately. Its species assignment is source-reported, not a substitute for the native taxonomy of a matched database entry. Heterologous susceptibility effects and biochemical findings are distinct; the paper discusses discordance between them.
inspected: selected identity and Results and discussion paragraphs
